name: Chat Trigger
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Chat Trigger node when building AI workflows for chatbots and other chat interfaces. You can configure how users access the chat, using one of n8n's provided interfaces, or your own. You can add authentication
authentication_methods: Basic Auth: The chat uses basic authentication
None: The chat doesn't use authentication. Anyone can use the chat
n8n User Auth: Only users logged in to an n8n account can use the chat

parameters.name: Make Chat Publicly Available
parameters.description: Set whether the chat should be publicly available (turned on) or only available through the manual chat interface (turned off)

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Choose how users access the chat. Select from:

parameters.description: Choose whether and how to restrict access to the chat. Select from:
options: None: The chat doesn't use authentication. Anyone can use the chat
Basic Auth: The chat uses basic authentication

parameters.name: Initial Message(s)
parameters.description: This parameter's only available if you're using Hosted Chat. Use it to configure the message the n8n chat interface displays when the user arrives on the page

common_issues.title: Pass data from a website to an embedded Chat Trigger node
common_issues.summary: When embedding the Chat Trigger node in a website, you might want to pass extra information to the Chat Trigger. For example, passing a user ID stored in a site cookie

common_issues.title: Chat Trigger node doesn't fetch previous messages
common_issues.summary: When you configure a Chat Trigger node, you might experience problems fetching previous messages if you aren't careful about how you configure session loading. This often manifests as a workflow could not be started! error
